headline: Approved FY27 eligibility determinations for 20 community preservation applications and a revised application form.
summary: Twelve applications were found eligible, six ineligible, and two are pending a Historic Commission determination. Bids for the remaining Jones Point work came in about $300,000 over budget. The Historic Commission is being reformed, with new member interviews set for October 7.
decisions: Approved all FY27 eligibility determinations for 20 applications unanimously, with six found ineligible.
Approved the revised FY27 Full Application with the “where applicable” amendment unanimously.
Agreed to hold hybrid meetings for substantial CPA business and keep procedural meetings on Zoom.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion to approve the August 12, 2026 minutes as submitted was made by Larose and seconded by Falcetti. The motion passed unanimously.
A motion to accept all eligibility determinations as presented was made by Larose and seconded by Falcetti. The motion passed unanimously.
A motion to approve the revised application with this amendment was made by Larose and seconded by Falcetti. The motion passed unanimously.
The committee agreed to hold hybrid meetings for substantial CPA business, such as presentations and budget votes, and to keep procedural meetings on Zoom.
